mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the discount rate for equity valuations, reducing present value and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS against 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a deteriorating housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1300 occurs in more than 40% of the 5-day return periods, but the 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in those instances.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between unemployment rate (UNRATE) and industrial production (INDPRO) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns, leading to negative returns when the interaction term (UNRATE * (100 - INDPRO)) is high over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * (100 - INDPRO)) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 against 60-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), INDPRO is below 100 in more than 60% of the periods, but the 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 3.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.0% occurs in more than 40% of the periods, but the 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in those instances.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between unemployment rate (UNRATE) and residential sales (RSAFS) is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns, leading to negative returns when the interaction term (UNRATE * (1000000 - RSAFS)) is high over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * (1000000 - RSAFS)) has a Rank IC less than 0.03 against 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 325), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 325), INDPRO is below 100 in more than 60% of the periods, but the 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals a deepening labor market crisis, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% occurs in more than 40% of the periods, but the 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in those instances.
